The AI company said it identified four broad categories of unintended model actions during evaluations and internal use of Claude - Claude Mythos

signals.title_orig: Microsoft AI Releases Microsoft-Decision-1: A Qwen3.5-9B Decision-Scoring Model
signals.summary_orig: Microsoft has released Microsoft-Decision-1, a decision model for routing, classification, verification and agent control. Microsoft-Decision-1 is a decision-scoring model that returns a calibrated probability for each fixed answer option instead of generated text. It is post-trained from Alibaba’s Qwen3.5-9B and available now in Microsoft Foundry and OpenRouter. . TL;DR What is a decision model?

signals.title_orig: Alibaba Qwen Releases Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo, an 8-Step 7B Image Model
signals.summary_orig: Alibaba’s Qwen team has released Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo, an accelerated checkpoint of its open-weight Qwen-Image-2.1 model. It generates and edits images in 8 denoising steps instead of the base model’s 40-step default. For developers, that means 5x fewer denoising steps on the same 7B architecture, plus a hosted API option. TL;DR What is Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo? Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo is an […] The post

signals.title: La API de decisiones de OpenAI alcanza la versión beta pública con respuestas escritas 10 veces más rápido
signals.summary: La API Decisions de OpenAI ya está en beta pública en GPT‑6 Luna, ofrece respuestas tipadas 10 veces más rápidas que la API Responses y cuesta $0,10 por millón de tokens de entrada, sin cargos por salida.
signals.title_orig: OpenAI Decisions API Hits Public Beta With 10x Faster Typed Answers
signals.summary_orig: OpenAI’s Decisions API is now in public beta on GPT-6 Luna. It returns typed probabilities, choices and scores about 10x faster than the Responses API, billing $0.10 per 1M input tokens with no output charges. The post OpenAI Decisions API Hits Public Beta With 10x Faster Typed Answers appeared first on MarkTechPost .
